logp.method_description: The flask-shaking method21 was used for determination of the partition coefficient (log P) as a measure of lipophilicity for [Zn(ebpy)Cl2 ]. This complex was dissolved in DMSO and added to water/n-octanol system. The obtained solution was vortexed for 1 h at ambient temperature and, after that, left to stand for additional 24 h until the separation of the two phases was achieved. The absorbance value was determined from the calibration curve and used for calculation of the concentration of the complex in n-octanol phase (co) and water phase (cw).
